text: {"observations":"The loudness envelope and band levels show five near-identical loud broadband bursts, each about 1.6-2 s long, at roughly 0.0-2.0 s, 2.8-4.7 s, 5.6-7.5 s, 8.4-10.3 s and 11.2-13.1 s, separated by gaps of complete silence (about 2.2-2.6, 4.8-5.3, 7.6-8.1, 10.4-10.9 s) and followed by silence to the end. Onset detection finds exactly 5 onsets (0.06, 2.85, 5.66, 8.45, 11.26 s), evenly spaced about 2.8 s apart. That gives five horn events, which rules in C and rules out 3, 4 and 6.","answer":"C"}
